q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month, or you can save 20% with annual billing.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team is $8 per user per month, so 5 people would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes on 1 device.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, you can get a full refund. Contact support with your order number—we refund Plus subscriptions within 14 days of purchase.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: No, refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase. Since your purchase was three weeks ago, it falls outside that window. I can open a support ticket for you if you'd like to discuss other options.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there is no Linux desktop app, but you can use the web app on Linux.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Android 12 or later is supported. Android 11 is not listed as a supported version.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs an internet connection to work. The mobile and desktop apps support offline use and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: No worries! Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Just open Trash, select your note, and click "Restore" to get it back.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS is not supported. We only support authenticator apps for two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus features until the end of your current billing period. To cancel, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves you 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use Plus on 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't have information about a student discount. I can open a support ticket for you if you'd like?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Example Notes is not mentioned as HIPAA compliant in our FAQ, so I don't have that information. Please email support@example.com to open a support ticket, and they'll be able to assist you.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know if notes can be imported from Evernote. I can open a support ticket for you to get an answer from our team.

answer: I don't have information about a Linux desktop app release date. You can use the web app on Linux, or I can open a support ticket if you'd like.

answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れました」をクリックしてください。30分で期限切れになるリセットリンクをメールでお送りします。
